text:
Asha (People Ops): Quick update 026 review cycle will use a staggered flow to reduce manager bottlenecks. Self-assessments first, manager reviews a week later.
Luis (Eng Manager): Sounds good. exact dates?
Asha (People Ops): Self-assess deadline: 2026-05-10 23:59 PT. Manager writeups: 2026-05-17 23:59 PT. Calibration panels: 2026-05-24 to 2026-05-28.
Sam (IC): I have a conference during manager writeups. Can my manager submit on my behalf?
Priya HR: Managers can submit provisional notes, but please add a short comment in the form saying 'IC at conference, evidence attached'. We'll treat it as normal for calibration.
Luis (Eng Manager): For teams with reviewers OOO, can we assign overflow reviewers?
Asha (People Ops): Yes. We'll publish an assignments CSV with primary + overflow by Monday EOD. Also adding a new column: "backup_reviewer".
Sam (IC): Will there be a live walkthrough of the new form sections?
Asha (People Ops): Two walkthroughs: Tue 9am PT and Thu 3pm PT, recorded to the HR wiki. Snippets + screenshots will be posted.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: draft window opens 72h before self-assessments are due. Auto-save enabled on web.
Luis (Eng Manager): Calibration format? cohort or org-wide?
Asha (People Ops): Cohort-based by function (eng, product, infra). Each cohort has an initial alignment + final signoff session. We'll publish meeting invites next week.
Priya HR: LOA / parental leave notes: if an IC is mid-cycle, manager should flag "LOA" in the context box and fill the LOA template. I will follow up with the template link here.
Sam (IC): Will accommodations be private?
Priya HR: Yes 026 privacy rules: accommodations and medical details stay in HR-only notes. Managers see only the accommodations summary.
Luis (Eng Manager): Reassigning a reviewer process?
Asha (People Ops): Email people-ops@redwood.com with reviewer to replace + new assignee. We handle the permission sync.
Sam (IC): tiny thing 026 can the form accept pasted markdown (code blocks)? sometimes i paste prompts as examples.
people-ops-bot: Note: form accepts plain text and simple formatting; triple-backtick code blocks render in the web form.
Asha (People Ops): Action items: 1) People Ops publish assignments CSV + invites. 2) HR post LOA template and privacy doc. 3) Managers collate cross-functional examples before writeups. 4) People Ops record walkthrough and post.
Luis (Eng Manager): I'll block time for managers to complete writeups.
Sam (IC): Appreciate the staggered flow 1 should make writing less frantic.
Priya HR: I'll drop the LOA template here in 10m.
Asha (People Ops): We'll run a short anonymous feedback survey after calibration. Thanks all. :sparkles:
